decisions.statement: Every tree read through here is read by one rule.
The repository root is the akasha folder itself.
The vendored packages and the quarantine are left out.
Git's own store is left out.
The index is left out.
Nothing left out of the tree has a page of this repository's own.
Each folder left out is named rather than matched on a leading dot.
The quarantine is left out only where the quarantine sits at the top of the tree.
A folder deeper down carrying that name has pages.
A folder deeper down carrying that name is read.
`.server/` under a router app has module pages a dot rule would drop.
A part naming a page left out of the tree is refused.
A page is a file whose name says a page type and no section.
The page types a tree admits are read from that tree's own page type pages.
A caller says which file names that caller takes.
The files and folders sitting in one folder are the ones git carries there.
A file git ignores and a file git was never told of are both left out.
A folder git carries nothing in is left out however much sits in it on disk.
A path under a folder git carries nothing in is carried by nothing either.
Git is asked what it carries rather than the ignore rules being read here.
What git carries is asked once for a repository and a commit, and held for the rest of the run.
A caller naming a commit is answered what git carried at that commit.
A path a commit after that one first carried is carried by nothing here.
What git carries now is asked before which commit that is, so a landing between them is left out.
A caller naming no commit is answered what git carries now.
A folder git will not answer for is the folder as it sits on disk.
Nothing here reads a page's body.
Nothing here reads or writes the index.
A caller says which folders that caller enters.
A caller saying nothing about folders enters every folder the rules here leave in.
A folder a lock is held in is left out, because a lock is there only while a call runs.

definition: the files under a tree, and the folders with no page of this repository's own
